props.description:
Label rendered in the card's top ribbon, used to emphasize a plan (e.g. "Most popular").
Every card reserves the same top ribbon area whether or not it carries a `ribbonLabel`,
so comparable cards stay aligned.
props.title: ribbonLabel

props.description:
Applies the fixed Plans 2.0 gradient treatment to the card. Ignored (fully suppressed)
whenever `ribbonLabel` is present.
props.title: gradient

props.description: Icon element to be rendered inside the bullet.
props.title: icon

props.description: Badge rendered inline after the bullet's content.
props.title: badge

props.description: Marks the feature as unavailable, applying the disabled visual treatment.
props.title: disabled

props.description:
Localized text describing why the feature is unavailable. Required
whenever `disabled` is `true`. Exposed only to assistive technology —
never visibly rendered — and has no default.
props.title: unavailableLabel

props.description:
Represents all of the things React can render.

Where {@link ReactElement} only represents JSX, `ReactNode` represents everything that can be rendered.
props.title: title

props.description: Tag rendered to the right of the header's supporting text (`subtitle`).
props.title: tag

props.description:
Represents all of the things React can render.

Where {@link ReactElement} only represents JSX, `ReactNode` represents everything that can be rendered.
props.title: children

props.description:
Current price of the plan. Formatting, currency, and localization are
consumer-owned — the component provides presentation only.
props.title: price

props.description: Previous price shown alongside the current price (e.g. to convey a discount).
props.title: previousPrice

props.description: Billing period or cadence for the price (e.g. "/month").
props.title: period

props.description: Additional note about the price, such as an annual billing clarification.
props.title: annualNote
